The tarball of backed-up directories (example config includes /etc/myapp) is created in shared /var/tmp with default umask permissions (typically world-readable), exposing its contents to other local users while it is built and uploaded.
Archives are uploaded to a third-party S3-compatible store with no client-side or server-side encryption (no ExtraArgs ServerSideEncryption), so backup contents rest in the bucket in plaintext.
The raw exception text (paths, bucket names, endpoint and botocore error details) is stored in the run result and served by the unauthenticated status endpoint.
Two required behaviours are untested: the --run-now command-line flag (main) and the run_forever scheduling loop; the tests only exercise helper functions.
